description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, it and Composer of Spring trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Composer of Spring trigger, putting Orzhov Basilica onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
